mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, it is 65 degrees under overcast skies near Reddan Soccer Park. We are currently in a New Moon phase, and while the International Space Station will pass overhead tonight, you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.
The Verona Common Council has unanimously adopted Envision Verona, a comprehensive plan created with extensive community input to guide growth, infrastructure, and housing over the next decade.
Today you can join a class for Yoga at Insight Wellness, followed by a busy tomorrow featuring trivia nights at Hop Haus and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a notable incident on October 3, local officers assisted the Cottage Grove Police Department by locating a 19-year-old suspect in Verona who was found to be in possession of a stolen firearm.
Satisfy your cravings with today's delicious Georgia Peach flavor when the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
